name: When do I need a plumber for standing water?

mainEntity.name: When do I need a plumber for standing water?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a plumber if standing water doesn't clear after attempting basic remedies like plunging, or if the problem recurs frequently. If multiple drains in your home are backed up, it indicates a more serious clog in the main sewer line, which definitely requires professional attention. A plumber has specialized tools like augers or hydro-jetting equipment to effectively clear stubborn or deep-seated clogs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a plumber if plunging doesn't work, if clogs are frequent, or if multiple drains are affected, indicating a main line issue.
